description: Use only AFTER match_offer identifies a verified AliEV paid-handoff offer and the human wants to review it before payment. Do not use for direct-checkout products; use get_live_checkout_offer and then prepare_verified_checkout after explicit payment confirmation. Creates only a human review URL, not checkout, invoice, payment obligation, entitlement, or fulfillment. Currently wired for AliEV only.

offer_key.description: AliEV offer key selected from the matched offer details.

public_id.description: Canonical AliEV public offer ID returned by match_offer.

request_id.description: Optional correlation ID for tracing the handoff without creating purchase state.
